order: alternate xdsl/pliron by repetition; single sequential CPU driver; no simultaneous timed candidates

definitions.author: xDSL fixture IR construction; Pliron fixture text construction. Different current authoring boundaries explicitly retained.
definitions.accept: Existing acceptance API, including its canonical serialization/reparse. Native total is current one-request CLI boundary.
definitions.prepare: Existing preparation API; xDSL A/C/mixed includes owner realization, B/extension includes local lowering; lifetime IR-only. Native IR requests exclude Python target materialization.
definitions.artifact_json_roundtrip: json.dumps+json.loads of whole artifact; not framework IR allocation or isolated IR print/parse.
definitions.cold: Existing raw saved-document verification API. xDSL A/C/mixed/B/extension includes target realization/local lowering; lifetime IR-only.
definitions.materialize: Existing Python materialization API; xDSL coupled cases repeats cold/preparation. Pliron includes a fresh native load round trip plus Python realization. Not factory-only.
definitions.end_to_end: Author, accept, prepare, Python materialization when needed, execute existing workflow and report. Independent oracle runs outside timer on every completed execution.
definitions.native_request_body_ns: Opt-in Instant span around existing run(): stdin read, request deserialization, accept/prepare/load and response JSON-value construction; excludes process startup and stdout serialization. Fresh native process on each request, never called warm native in-process.
definitions.native_serialize_ns: Serialize the Rust Result outcome envelope holding the response JSON value; telemetry wrapping, stdout flush and VmHWM read excluded. This is an opt-in profiling boundary, not isolated normal CLI serialization.
definitions.parent_json_encode_decode_ns: Measured within current process bridge, separately from total subprocess elapsed; no subtraction used to infer process startup or intrinsic framework costs.
definitions.fresh_process: Parent wall time across spawn/import/full end-to-end primary unfused case/exit; worker records import phase and full operation separately. Native CLI cost stays included.
definitions.peak_memory: Linux parent ru_maxrss KiB and each native child /proc/self/status VmHWM KiB, separately. Not added, not simultaneous total, not retained IR allocation.

unmeasured: isolated IR parse/print for every API (bundled within actual accept/cold)

policy.gc: enabled; gc.collect once between phases, never timed
policy.caches: existing imports warmed; fresh contexts/owners per preparation; OS caches unflushed; each native request spawns a new process
policy.gil: observe ordinary imports; never force off

failure_policy: Persist every attempted sample, command, stdout/stderr and exception. No resampling, silent retries or favorable subset. Failed correctness blocks affected interpretation.
legacy_progress: Record current isolated GIL-disabled xDSL/native returning-filter feedback checks and import state. Legacy combined-suite .31.23 remains open; do not claim root cause fixed.

api_boundaries.B_extension: prepare and cold use public APIs that include local binding/resource lowering on both frontends; native core body is also instrumented inside the CLI. materialize repeats cold in both.
api_boundaries.A_C_mixed: xDSL prepare/cold include owner realization; Pliron prepare/cold are native requests, materialize includes another native cold validation plus owner realization. No subtraction claims pure IR costs.
api_boundaries.lifetime: prepare/cold independently validate IR; materialize includes cold validation and shared owner realization on both. End-to-end uses the existing late-input pressure driver, including its materialization.
